seed_notes.ABANTU_BATHO_CONGRESS: entrant from nothing: even share of every pool. Sized at the EXPECTED result for the 73 arrivals that contested about as much of a city (18% of wards): mean 0.21%, median 0.05%. Band 0.03%-0.89% on the record, carried across as a RELATIVE width.
